faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Associate post at IIT Roorkee is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Masters in Physics or equivalent disciplines, or a B.E./B.Tech. degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate position ranges from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 55,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in date for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The walk-in date for the Project Associate position is scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The official website of IIT Roorkee is not provided in the extracted data, but it is generally iitr.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee is Contractual.
